entities.name: PMID:27508934
observations: 2016 broiler study tested butyrate glycerides using RNA-seq of jejunum and liver; abstract reports 79 jejunal and 205 hepatic characterized DEGs and lipid-metabolism pathway changes.

entities.name: BG lipid-catabolism transcriptomics
observations: In young broilers, butyrate glycerides were associated with hepatic gene sets indicating increased lipid/fatty-acid oxidation, induction of THRSP and EGR-1, and induction of unspecified PPAR-alpha pathway DEGs; abdominal-fat ratio also decreased. Individual gene effect sizes are not stated in the retrieved abstract.
